questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
The structure around the exams are very hard to figure out, so be patient with that.
The housing can be difficult and expensive 
Go to markeds and use a lot of money on great food around the city, it doesn't get better than in Bologna.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: That the type of exam that is shown on the couse desription is not nessesarily the one you will end up doing.

questions.answer: Getting new friends and having new indsights on how you can do university

questions.answer: Figuring out the systems of the courses and exams.
